title: AirStack module manifest (module.yaml)
description: The thin module manifest from RFC #379 §2: dependencies, identity, and test metadata only. Wiring (topics, remaps, slots) deliberately does NOT live here — a module's interface is its launch file's declared args plus the interface conventions spec. Consumed by tools/validate_module.py, which interprets the draft-07 subset: type, required, properties, enum, pattern, items, additionalProperties, minLength, minItems, plus the custom x-airstack-* annotations documented in common/module_schema/README.md.

name.description: Module identity: lowercase snake_case, starts with a letter.

description.description: One-line human description shown in the registry catalog.

maintainer.description: Named maintainer email — required by governance (RFC #379 §8).

license.description: SPDX-style license string; checked at registration.

type.description: What kind of module this is (platform is future — RFC #380 §6).

airstack_compat.description: Semver range vs trunk .env VERSION, e.g. ">=0.19.0 <0.21.0". Branch names and partial versions are invalid.

deps.description: Dependency tier 1 (RFC #379 §6). rosdep keys live in package.xml, not here.

dockerfile.description: Dependency tier 2: repo-relative path to a Dockerfile.module written against ARG BASE_IMAGE, never a fixed base.

overlay_image.description: Dependency tier 3: prebuilt overlay image reference for monster deps.

compose.description: Optional repo-relative docker compose fragment (mounts, env).

assets.description: Large assets fetched to cache by `airstack sync` — no Git LFS in module repos (RFC #379 §10).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the asset.

dest.description: Destination path relative to the module checkout; never absolute, never escaping via '..'.

docs.description: Docs entry points embedded on the versioned site (RFC #379 §9): {readme: path} or {dir: path, nav: path}.

foxglove.description: Optional Foxglove layout/panel fragment so operators can see the module in the field.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks. Contract for every hook script: idempotent, never uses sudo, writes only inside the module checkout.

host_setup.description: Script run on the host after sync (precedent: the asm_optitrack module's natnet_ros2/scripts/download-natnet-sdk.sh). Must be idempotent, no sudo, and write only inside the module checkout.

tests.description: Test metadata: colcon unit-test packages (co-located test/) and the system-test marks the module's CI runs (RFC #379 §5).
